title: the update's size check on a site's database roles
note: basis 'shown' means shown by the card's local runs (a local PostgreSQL 16 cluster with the roles made by the install's own db-init scripts, git ancestry of the walk box's releases); the bench host, Docker and the box rehearsal were not run.

findings.claim: the walk box's update ran its installed release's update.py (apply_update.sh runs the installed tree), installed before H-99: it read pg_database_size('hapi') as trialbox on trialbox_wf, refused on a site's roles with the walk's exact error; master's reads were already right, so a box installed before a9cc50c9 cannot update until it is reinstalled once
findings.fix: one reinstall with the bootstrap on such a box (the walk did it); the walk's next update is the proof; H-124 for the class (H121-06)

findings.claim: nothing in CI runs an update with the previous release's update path (the box rehearsal installs and never updates; the update drill runs the in-process box), so a fault in an installed release's update path is first seen on a real box
findings.fix: card H-123 (the rehearsal updates from release N-1)

findings.claim: ComposeBox's size reads never ran against the box's real database container in CI; the rehearsal's doctor phase now checks that trialbox cannot connect to hapi and that db_size reads both databases with DB_SIZE_ROLES through the box's own command line
findings.fix: H-121 (this card); the rehearsal job on its pull request is the first run

findings.claim: space_needs counted 0 for a size answer that was not a number (psql succeeded but printed none), so the space check went on without that database; now it stops the update with the same plain line; the fakes of the update tests (test_update_path.py FakeRun, test_host_tree.py STAND_IN_DOCKER, one runner in test_update_safety.py) now answer the size query, no assertion changed

the change was not run on the bench host, with Docker or in the box rehearsal: the size reads ran on a local PostgreSQL 16 cluster with the roles of the install's own db-init scripts; the rehearsal check's seconds are an estimate
findings.fix: the rehearsal job on the pull request, and the walk's next update on the bench host

findings.claim: the update's checks and its applying code run from the INSTALLED tree, never from the signed new bundle: tools/apply_update.sh sets ROOT from its own folder (line 55), cd "$ROOT" (line 262) and runs python3 -m tools.trialbox update (line 267), which imports tools/trialbox/update.py from that tree (tools/trialbox/__main__.py line 341; install.sh line 810 links /usr/local/bin/trialbox to the installed __main__.py); so a fault in an installed release's update code cannot be fixed by a new bundle, only by a reinstall
findings.fix: card H-124 (the update's code from the signed bundle, verified with the installed vendor key)

findings.claim: OCR 1469-7's follow-up: backup_schedule.volume_bytes and Updater._audit_waits still read the host's default engine folders in the update tests (present on master; both catch OSError); their tests' box .env should name a TB_DOCKER_VOLUMES of their own
OCR 1469-4's follow-up: tools/trialbox/box_restore.py still writes the size roles out instead of using DB_SIZE_ROLES; its lines are #1470's (H-126)
findings.fix: H-129, after #1470 merges (test_1469_4_the_role_pairs_are_written_once names it until then)
